summary_md: **Nikola Toshev ([@ntoshev](https://x.com/ntoshev/status/2116101985472491919))** starts a thread on **distill**, a local MLX tool for training, visualizing and continually learning: it shows per-token surprise for a prompt, on-policy distillation where a teacher with privileged context guides a student, and teaching Qwen3.5-0.8B a code word in 22 steps via a small LoRA ([ntoshev/distill](https://github.com/ntoshev/distill)).

referenced_urls.title: GitHub - ntoshev/distill: continual learning via internalizing context into model weights via LoRA OPSD

relevance: Hands-on continual learning by internalizing context into weights on a laptop.
